texts: bad: "fall on day 17 of Year 1" was taken literally — the query invents a separate falling event with the harvest as its object and puts the date on that falling, so it asks the reason for a fall rather than the reason the harvest was on day 17. Date the harvest with a plain light verb instead: "Why did the thread harvest at the Middle Row take place on day 17 of Year 1?" If you actually meant the yield dropped that day, say so with an unambiguous verb: "Why did the thread harvest at the Middle Row decline on day 17 of Year 1?"
